component.name: Origa
component.summary: Learn Japanese — kanji, vocabulary and grammar with spaced repetition

description.p: Origa is a spaced-repetition trainer for Japanese. It covers kanji, vocabulary and grammar from JLPT N5 to N1 and schedules reviews with the FSRS algorithm.

Study materials are downloaded once and cached on the device, so the app works fully offline. Kanji include stroke-order animations, vocabulary entries come with pitch-accent audio, and lessons grade free-form answers instead of multiple choice.
